'''0.26e''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added special Christmas-themed features to the lobby and game.

==Changelog==
* Added Christmas tree to lobby
* Basic sweater will now be decorated with deers
* Every player logging in until the 7th of January, 23:00 GMT+2 will receive a holiday camouflage
